description: This file defines a factory function to generate standard CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) REST controllers for Mongoose models, including in-memory micro-caching for list endpoints. It handles filtering, pagination, error mapping, and response formatting, making it a core component for API route handling.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached list response if available and not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a list response in the in-memory cache with TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Creates a stable cache key based on request parameters for list endpoints.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError(res, err, context = 'operation')
methods.description: Maps Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP failure responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with optional pagination, filtering, sorting, and micro-caching.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by its MongoDB _id.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document in the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing document by its _id.
